semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company focuses on integrating 2D materials into silicon-based semiconductors, which is relevant to advanced semiconductor applications.
summary: 2D-Pilot Line is engaged in a European-funded project aimed at integrating transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) into silicon-based semiconductor platforms. They provide multi-project wafer (MPW) runs for customer-designed components, supporting a variety of photonic and electronic applications.
capabilities: Integration of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) into silicon platforms
Multi-project wafer (MPW) runs for graphene and TMDC-based devices
Development of integration modules for photonic and electronic devices
technical_expertise: Integration of nanomaterials into semiconductor processes

regional_presence.Europe: The project is funded by European initiatives, indicating a strategic focus on the European semiconductor landscape.
